public_redaction: This receipt preserves the reviewer verdict, opinions, grades, recommendations, and disagreements while removing private execution and account details from the public copy.

publication_safety.privacy_opinion: Public surface stays clean: empty positions, zero closed trades, hash-only receipts, and no quantities, fills, balances, NLV, or absolute dollar P&L. Aggregate marked/realized basis-relative P&L is a coarse band only, which is acceptable given the already-disclosed ~six-figure virtual basis; unrealized is an honest flat zero. Symbol names appear only as unresolved research dispositions without size or price reconstruction handles.
publication_safety.statistical_opinion: Statistically honest. Binding story is infrastructure failure and halt, not edge. Zero matured brackets, empty deterministic ledger, correlated sector-pair cohort clustering, low-information late QQQ shadow, and explicit separation of shadows from expectancy/fills/unlock are stated without alpha framing. Tiny and unresolved samples are not dressed up as results.

strategy_critique.opinion: Correct fail-closed day: flat cash is the only integrity-compliant outcome while quote guards, entry artifacts, observation round-trip, exit-schema validation, and unlock-contract migration remain broken. The executable aggressive book is still one pooled level/VWAP family wearing two labels; that monoculture call is right and must stay unpromoted. Highest leverage is not a new entry idea—it is proving registration→ledger→report parity and freezing complete three-arm exit blocks before any scoring resumes. Sector-pair is the best distinct shadow; quality MR and puts are correctly blocked before observation one / capability collection. Keep disagreements about reclaim iterate-vs-shadow-primary unresolved in public; do not resolve them by loosening gates.
strategy_critique.mechanism_overlap: Day-two continuation and negative-catalyst reclaim collapse to the same completed level-break/reclaim + VWAP confirmation family. Same-session sector-pair legs are one correlated decision-date cohort, not two independent observations. Late underlying QQQ breakdown is not an options-continuation observation. Labels still outrun mechanism diversity.
missed_alternatives: Post-event gap-fill mean reversion (>2.5 ATR non-structural gap, failed first-hour extension, close back inside range; counter-direction to day-two continuation)
Earnings implied-move mispricing (gap vs ex-ante ATM straddle; requires point-in-time option snapshots before scoring)

bounded_recommendations.benchmark_or_control: Production ledger row count and learning-report families=[] baseline before pre-flight; success is registration→control→ledger→report parity with journal-ID idempotency.
bounded_recommendations.minimum_sample: 1 clean end-to-end prospective registration in sandbox plus 1 replay of an archived integrity fixture (DIS dislocation / trade-through).
bounded_recommendations.promotion_rule: Only after sandbox parity: separately reviewed production backfill with exact journal-ID parity and idempotency proof may run; scoring unfreezes only when deterministic rows are nonzero and match registrations.

disagreements_to_preserve: Fable vs Grok on whether reclaim should stay iterative research under halt versus become shadow-primary while integrity is red—public correctly leaves allowlist unchanged and entries halted.

Config/governor still requires 20 eligible aggressive closes at >= +0.30R average while owner directive points at three eligible closes with positive average R; contradiction is an execution-integrity gate, not a license to pick the easier threshold.
Registry/label diversity vs sampled-evidence monoculture: multiple named lanes do not equal independent mechanisms until ledger rows exist by family.

result.summary: PASS both tracks. Public candidate is privacy-safe and statistically sober: flat paper book, coarse basis-relative band only, unresolved/correlated shadows not sold as alpha, halt binding on empty ledger and integrity gaps. Strategy posture is correct fail-closed monoculture diagnosis; next work is measurement/sandbox parity, frozen sector-pair shadows, complete three-arm exit validation, and option pagination receipts—no orders, no gate loosening, no promotion.
